policy.host_role: load image, transport arguments, forward receipts

word.output: full training-vocabulary word IDs, top-5 and loss

token.output: full GPT-2 vocabulary token IDs, top-5 and loss

switching: load(kind) releases the previous VM before constructing the next; an unloaded runtime cannot execute a projection
note: This is a host-side composition boundary, not host mathematical projection. It prevents two count-table layouts from aliasing in one 128 MiB guest.
